decision_body: W-141 scoping: OP-1 — pure rect-geometry helpers (placement_full_rect, placement_rect, viewport_extent, cell_span) STAY in Core as placement policy (they encode anchor/scroll/viewport semantics); only the pixel-scaling step (rasterize/rasterize_clipped) moves. OP-2 — config-file background decode (background.rs) is OUT of W-141 scope; the W-133 contract names only the Kitty/APC protocol path, and background stays whole in bitty-rich untouched.
title: W-141 OP-1/OP-2: rect helpers stay; background out of scope
